title: Review event (D26)
description: One review decision, written as its own object at review/events/pending/<YYYYMMDDTHHMMSSZ>-<id>.json (UTC creation time, then the event id). Writers: the CLI, the local review page and the review Function (actor = Cloudflare Access e-mail). The pipeline applies pending events oldest first, re-checking the transition against the deal's status at that moment, and moves each to review/events/archive/<YYYY-MM>/<same name> wrapped as {"event": <this object>, "outcome": "applied"|"refused"|"malformed", "reason", "settled_at", ...}. Never edit or reuse an event: write a new one.

id.description: UUID v4, lower case; also the end of the object key. Applying an id twice is a no-op.

created_at.description: When the reviewer decided, UTC with a Z suffix. Becomes reviewed_at / published_at.

actor.description: Who decided: 'cli:<user>@<host>', 'review-page:<user>@<host>', the Access e-mail, or 'instagram-publisher' (a published event the pipeline writes after its Instagram post went out, D36).

note.description: Free text from the reviewer (approve, reject).

post_url.description: Link to the published post; only on 'published' events.

live_check.description: The live price check done right before writing an approval (required, and valid, on 'approve'; null otherwise). An approval whose checked_at is older than the snapshot's review_rules.approve_max_age_hours (24) when the pipeline applies it is refused.

price_eur.description: Cheapest price of the same trip right now.
